articles.title: Nuvama Wealth Management Q2 Results: Profit rises 19% YoY to Rs 304 crore
articles.desc: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd achieved a consolidated net profit of Rs 303.5 crore for Q2 FY27. The company saw a revenue increase of 20.35% to Rs 1,366 crore for the same quarter. Client assets reached Rs 5.5 lakh crore, reflecting a 25% year-on-year growth. Wealth management, asset services, and capital markets drove this substantial growth. The company demonstrated strong operating profits with a return on equity remaining robust at 29%.

articles.title: Nvidia falls about 3% in after-hours and perpetual futures trade
articles.desc: Nvidia's shares saw a decline in after-hours trading following an announcement regarding CEO Jensen Huang. The company indicated that it is investigating potential foreign intelligence efforts aimed at Huang. Perpetual futures on the Hyperliquid exchange and shares trading on the Blue Ocean system reflected this drop in value. The share price fell approximately 3.4% compared to Friday's Nasdaq closing price.

articles.title: Citi bullish on Indian equities, sees Nifty at 28,000 by end-2027
articles.desc: Citi Research projects that India's benchmark Nifty 50 index could hit 28,000 points by the end of 2027. This forecast is based on strong earnings prospects and falling oil prices. Recent foreign portfolio investor activity has contributed significantly to the positive sentiment in the equity market. Additionally, lower oil prices could improve macroeconomic conditions and reduce inflation rates in India.
